summary: When you want something, you want it all the way. There's a force in you that doesn't do half-measures. Drive and power run together, so your will can move mountains or turn into a battle nobody can win.
body: When you want something, you want it all the way. There's a force in you that doesn't do half-measures. Drive and power run together, so your will can move mountains or turn into a battle nobody can win. Power may not feel neutral here. It can register as something tied to safety, control, and the need to protect yourself. You may push with an intensity that overwhelms people, or get locked in struggles you can't let go of. The work is aiming the force at transformation instead of domination.
gift: At your best: unstoppable, regenerative, able to do what takes raw power.
shadow: The trap: power struggles, compulsion, and burning the engine on a grudge.
integration: Let drive and anger and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Formidable drive; temper and overkill are the dangers.
do: Aim the force at a goal, not a person
Let go of the fight you can't win clean
Use the intensity to transform, not control
